subject: Execution bridge & stakeholder commitments — Stellarus MAP and timeline
messages:
From: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@stellarus.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-19T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Execution bridge & stakeholder commitments — Stellarus MAP and timeline

Alex — thanks for the kickoff yesterday. Per our conversation I put together a concise Mutual Action Plan (MAP) draft and an "execution bridge" (milestone-focused timeline) to make responsibilities and acceptance criteria explicit. Attached: Stellarus_MAP_v0.9.xlsx (high-level MAP) and ingestion_spec_v1.pdf (initial data contract).

High-level timeline (proposed)
- Week 1 (Oct 19–25): Project kickoff + environment access; Redwood to provision test workspace. Owner: Marissa Cole. Acceptance: test workspace reachable from Stellarus network and SSO validated.
- Week 2–3 (Oct 26–Nov 8): Data ingestion & schema validation. Owner: Monica Patel. Acceptance: sample dataset loaded to staging and passes schema checks.
- Week 4 (Nov 9–15): Model routing & latency baseline tests (hosted vs dedicated). Owner: Ben Carter. Acceptance: P95 latency <= 250ms on sample traffic.
- Week 5 (Nov 16–22): User-acceptance testing (UAT) + roll plan. Owners: Stellarus PM (Rachel Li) + Redwood PM. Acceptance: UAT checklist signed off.

Dependencies and risks (short list)
- Network firewall rules (customer action) — ETA required by Oct 22 to avoid slip.
- Data retention/legal review — if SOC/audit items surface we may need a 2-week extension.

Asks
1) Alex/Rachel: please confirm the Stellarus owners for firewall and legal (names and target dates).
2) Internal team: confirm owners and flag any resource conflicts this month.

I'll schedule a 30-minute owner sync for Monday Oct 19 3:00 PM PT unless you prefer another slot.

Best,
Avery Johnson
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Stellarus_MAP_v0.9.xlsx (spreadsheet), ingestion_spec_v1.pdf (pdf)
From: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@stellarus.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rachel Li <rachel.li@stellarus.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-19T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Execution bridge & stakeholder commitments — Stellarus MAP and timeline

Thanks Avery — this is helpful and wow, very crisp. Two quick items from our side:
1) Firewall/network: I'll own coordination with our infra team. Target to get rules opened by Oct 22 but I need to confirm the specific IP ranges — will follow up by EOD Oct 20.
2) Legal/retention: I'm looping Rachel (PM) and copying our security lead (not on this thread yet). We have a standing compliance review next Thu (Oct 22) — worst case we see questions that require the extra 2-week buffer.

Kickoff: Oct 19 3:00 PM PT works for me. Rachel — can you attend? Also adding our data engineer, Priya Sen (priya.sen@stellarus.com), to the invite for Week 2 ingestion planning.

Appreciate the plan.
Alex
Director, Platform Engineering
Stellarus Health
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-20T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Execution bridge & stakeholder commitments — Stellarus MAP and timeline

Looping in a few internal notes after reading Alex's reply and scanning the MAP attachment. Quoted below for context.

> Alex: "I'll own coordination with our infra team. Target to get rules opened by Oct 22..."

Internal takeaways and proposed adjustments:
- Marissa: please proceed with provisioning the test workspace today; confirm workspace URL + admin creds once done. I'll add a brief runbook to the Drive link.
- Monica: data ingestion has the highest risk given their PI-heavy payloads. Need your assessment on whether we can support streaming ingest in Week 2 or if we should scope a batch-only MVP to hit our baseline dates. If batch-only, propose pushing schema sign-off to Nov 1 and sample load by Nov 3.
- Contingency: if firewall delay > 72 hours, we spin up a fenced test VM in a public cloud and run the connectivity tests there (notify Alex/Rachel).

Action items I will take on: prepare the latency baseline harness and a simple perf checklist (P95, error rate, mem/CPU). Target to drop into Drive by Oct 21 EOD. Link: https://drive.redwood.com/drive/folders/0B7-Stellarus-MAP

Please reply with confirmations so I can update the MAP (versioning) and lock calendar invites.

Ben
Principal Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-21T16:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Execution bridge & stakeholder commitments — Stellarus MAP and timeline

Confirmed — I will own ingestion. Quick read on scope: for Week 2 let's target a batch-first MVP (sample CSV load + schema validation) to keep the critical path short. I'll aim to have schema mapping and sample load instructions by Oct 27. If Stellarus can commit Priya for a 2-hour working session the week of Oct 26, we can try to accelerate to streaming in a subsequent sprint.

Marissa — I assume provisioning is done per Ben's ask; if not, flag and I will push my dates.

I'll update the MAP spreadsheet with the ingestion acceptance checklist and owner contact.

Monica Patel
Senior Data Engineer, Customer Success
Redwood Inference
